title: There & Back & There & Back Again
author: Shell Stowell
problems: Row 2 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 4 "next neighbors allemande left once" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 3 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
Row 6 "prev neighbors gyre left shoulders once" can't start from where the dancers are: gyre who must be one of partner, neighbor, larks, robins; got previous-neighbor.
Row 7 "neighbors allemande right 1½ to form long waves with robins facing out" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 3 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
choices: Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
